comment: Pixel positions on the 640x360 battle scene. Shared by the game (src/ui/main.ts) and tools/gen-battle.mjs. anchors[side][slot] is where a food stands (bottom-centre of its sprite, drawn 64x64: 32x32 art at 2x); slot = lane + 3 * row, row 0 = front. Plates are [cx, cy, rx, ry] ellipses; other rects are [x, y, w, h].

trays.comment: World rect of the left tray (x0..x1 across, z0..z1 depth); the right one is mirrored. See tools/gen-battle.mjs.
